messages.subject: Why no faceting?
parts: Can you speak briefly to why faceting is not likely to be supported by ggvis (except in the form of embedded plots)? Is it just going to be so easy to create multiple plots that you don't feel like it needs to be explicitly supported by the syntax, or have you had a philosophical shift away from faceted plots?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Why no faceting?
parts:
It's more that I think facetting is a special case of embedded plots, and will fall out naturally with just a couple of helper functions.

And embedded plots are a very natural fit to vega's group mark - I don't think implementing subplots will be hard. 

Hadley
